title: Wrexham boss Parkinson 'probably under pressure' for first time
summary: Wrexham has made no wins this season, and ex-Wales striker Iwan Roberts believes manager Phil Parkinson is facing pressure for the first time in his role. The club's poor start marks a significant shift in the manager's previously secure position.
content: With no wins yet this season, ex-Wales striker Iwan Roberts believes Phil Parkinson is probably under pressure for the first time as Wrexham boss.

zh.title: 雷克瑟姆主帅帕金森可能首次面临压力
zh.summary: 雷克瑟姆本赛季未尝胜绩，前威尔士前锋伊万·罗伯茨认为主帅菲尔·帕金森面临职业生涯中的首次压力。俱乐部糟糕的开局表明了主帅以前稳固地位的重大转变。

title: Tottenham make Ndiaye move with Richarlison set for Everton
summary: Tottenham are in advanced negotiations to sign winger Iliman Ndiaye from Everton, with Richarlison moving to Everton in a related but separate transaction. The deal represents a significant player exchange between the two clubs.
content: Tottenham are in advanced talks to sign Iliman Ndiaye from Everton, with Richarlison set to move in the opposite direction as part of separate negotiations.

zh.title: 热刺签约恩迪亚耶，里沙利松转会埃弗顿
zh.summary: 热刺正在与埃弗顿进行高级谈判签约边锋伊利曼·恩迪亚耶，同时里沙利松将转会埃弗顿，这是一项相关但独立的交易。这笔交易代表了两家俱乐部之间的重大球员交换。

title: Teenage Cardiff midfielder Donczew joins Arsenal
summary: Young midfielder Axel Donczew has joined Arsenal from Cardiff City as part of the Premier League champions' first-year scholarship intake. The transfer offers the teenager the opportunity to develop at an elite club.
content: Cardiff City teenager Axel Donczew has joined Arsenal as part of the Premier League champions' first-year scholarship intake.

zh.title: 卡迪夫年轻中场球员多恩采夫加盟阿森纳
zh.summary: 年轻中场球员阿克塞尔·多恩采夫从卡迪夫城加盟英超冠军阿森纳，成为该队一年级奖学金培养计划的一部分。这次转会为这名少年提供了在精英俱乐部发展的机会。

title: Boreham Wood accept Vardy-beating record fee for Abdulmalik
summary: Swedish club Djurgardens have agreed to pay a National League record fee exceeding £1.5 million for winger Abdul Abdulmalik from Boreham Wood. The transfer sets a new benchmark for player sales from the National League.
content: Swedish club Djurgardens agree a National League record fee thought to be in excess of £1.5m to sign winger Abdul Abdulmalik from Boreham Wood.

zh.title: 博勒汉姆伍德接受打破瓦迪纪录的转会费，引进阿卜杜尔马利克
zh.summary: 瑞典俱乐部迪加登已同意支付超过150万英镑的全国联赛创纪录转会费，从博勒汉姆伍德引进边锋阿卜杜尔·阿卜杜尔马利克。这次转会为全国联赛球员转会费创造了新的基准。

title: Everton call off Armstrong sale after fan backlash
summary: Everton have canceled plans to sell midfielder Harrison Armstrong to Nottingham Forest following strong fan opposition. Supporter backlash forced the club to reverse its decision on the transfer.
content: Everton have called off a proposed deal to sell midfielder Harrison Armstrong to Nottingham Forest following a backlash from the club's supporters.

zh.title: 埃弗顿因球迷反对取消阿姆斯特朗转会
zh.summary: 埃弗顿因球迷的强烈反对而取消了向诺丁汉森林出售中场球员哈里森·阿姆斯特朗的计划。球迷的强烈反对迫使俱乐部改变了这笔转会的决定。

title: Martinez is eighth Chelsea-Villa deal in four years
summary: Emiliano Martinez's transfer marks the eighth player deal between Aston Villa and Chelsea in four years. The two Premier League clubs have become frequent trading partners with consistent business between them.
content: After Emiliano Martinez's move, BBC Sport looks at why Aston Villa and Chelsea have become one of the Premier League’s busiest transfer partnerships since 2022.

zh.title: 马丁内斯是四年内切尔西与阿斯顿维拉的第八笔交易
zh.summary: 埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯的转会标志着阿斯顿维拉与切尔西在四年内的第八笔球员交易。这两家英超俱乐部已成为经常性的交易伙伴，双方之间的转会生意持续不断。

title: 'Sevelj poised for Dundee United exit to Neftci Baku' - gossip
summary: Reports indicate Dundee United have agreed a fee for midfielder Vicko Sevelj to join Azerbaijan club Neftci Baku. Separately, St Mirren appear set to sign a Serbian striker while Monaco are linked with Rangers' Djeidi Gassama.
content: Dundee United reportedly agree a fee for Vicko Sevelj to join Neftci Baku as St Mirren appear poised to sign a Serbian striker on Sunday and Monaco are linked with Rangers' Djeidi Gassama.

zh.title: 塞维尔即将离开邓迪联队加盟巴库涅夫特奇 - 转会传言
zh.summary: 报道显示邓迪联队已同意转会费，中场球员塞维尔将加盟阿塞拜疆俱乐部巴库涅夫特奇。与此同时，圣米伦似乎准备签下一名塞尔维亚前锋，摩纳哥则与流浪者队的加萨马存在关联。

title: Barcola - the 'grasshopper' who has overcome setbacks
summary: Liverpool have agreed a £123 million deal to sign forward Bradley Barcola, whose journey includes overcoming significant setbacks with family support. The transfer highlights his persistence in reaching elite football.
content: As Liverpool agree a £123m deal for Bradley Barcola, BBC Sport looks at how he has ridden triumphs and setbacks to reach the top with the help of his family.

zh.title: 巴尔科拉 - 克服困难的"蚱蜢"
zh.summary: 利物浦同意以1.23亿英镑的价格签下前锋布拉德利·巴尔科拉，他在家人支持下克服了重大困难。这笔转会凸显了他坚持不懈地追求顶级足球职业的精神。

title: Antonio helps young Ghanaians chase Premier League dreams
summary: Former West Ham striker Michail Antonio is mentoring young players from a Ghana academy who traveled to England pursuing professional football careers. The initiative provides these aspiring athletes guidance in the English football system.
content: Former West Ham forward Michail Antonio is helping players from a Ghana academy, who have travelled to England in the hope of turning pro.

zh.title: 安东尼奥帮助年轻加纳球员追逐英超梦想
zh.summary: 前西汉姆联队前锋米开·安东尼奥正在指导来自加纳足球学院的年轻球员，他们赴英格兰追求职业足球生涯。该倡议为这些有抱负的运动员提供了英超足球体系的指导。

title: Flex your football brain with our daily quizzes
summary: BBC Football offers daily trivia challenges including "Who Am I?", "Five in Five", and "Brainteaser" for fans to test their football knowledge. The interactive quizzes provide entertainment and a chance for supporters to prove their expertise.
content: Test your ball knowledge against today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser.

zh.title: 用每日问答展现你的足球知识
zh.summary: BBC足球频道提供每日琐事挑战，包括"我是谁？"、"五分钟五题"和"脑筋急转弯"，让球迷测试他们的足球知识。这些互动问答提供了娱乐和让支持者证明他们专业知识的机会。
